name: Jules
official_status_notes: Google's async GitHub coding agent: clones repo to cloud VM, plans with Gemini, proposes PR (verified site Sep 2026): free 15 tasks/day; Pro 100/day; Ultra 300/day.
pricing_summary: Free tier with daily limits; Pro/Ultra tiers with more tasks.
best_for: Delegating well-scoped GitHub tasks to a PR-producing cloud agent.
strengths: Free tier, async cloud execution, clear plan-then-PR flow.
weaknesses: Cloud-only (code leaves your machine); task limits.
